suggestions.title: Increase engagement rate on high-traffic days
suggestions.problem: On 20260820, 9 sessions generated only 1 engaged session (11% engagement rate), while on 20260815, 8 sessions generated 5 engaged sessions (63% engagement rate). Traffic doesn't correlate with engagement.
suggestions.root_cause: High session volume may indicate traffic from less relevant sources (e.g., unfiltered social sharing, poor ad targeting), or landing page content isn't compelling enough to convert casual visitors into engaged users.
suggestions.suggestion: Analyze traffic sources for 20260820 vs 20260815 to identify which channels drive higher-quality visitors. Create landing page A/B tests with clearer CTAs (e.g., 'Browse featured bakeries' buttons, high-quality hero images of featured cafes). Implement scroll-tracking to identify where users drop off.
suggestions.expected_impact: Convert the 8 non-engaged sessions on high-traffic days into engaged sessions, potentially increasing daily engagement rate from 11% to 50%+, adding 4-5 engaged sessions per day.
suggestions.implementation_note: Add UTM parameters to all social/external links: '?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=chirumaru_discovery'. Track with Google Analytics 4 event: gtag('event', 'page_engagement', {engagement_type: 'scroll_50pct'});

suggestions.title: Stabilize traffic and implement consistent content cadence
suggestions.problem: Sessions fluctuate significantly (2-9 per day), with an average of only 6.3 sessions/day. 20260816 dropped to just 2 sessions, suggesting no predictable traffic pattern.
suggestions.root_cause: Likely due to inconsistent social media posting schedule, no regular content calendar, or lack of recurring 'must-visit' features (e.g., weekly bakery spotlights, weekend cafe guides) that users expect.
suggestions.suggestion: Establish a consistent posting schedule: post 3-4 times weekly (e.g., Mon/Wed/Fri) with themed content (Monday: New Bakeries, Wednesday: User Reviews, Friday: Weekend Specials). Create a content calendar for the next 30 days and promote recurring features like '#Chirumaru金曜日のカフェ' to build habit-forming discovery patterns.
suggestions.expected_impact: Stabilize daily sessions to 12-15/day (2x current average) and reduce day-to-day variance. Recurring themes create predictable audience return patterns, increasing repeat visitors by 30-40%.
suggestions.implementation_note: Content calendar template: {date: '20260821', post_type: 'bakery_spotlight', bakery_name: '〇〇ベーカリー', platforms: ['instagram', 'twitter'], hashtags: ['#ちるまる', '#パン屋さんとの繋がり']}

suggestions.title: Reduce bounce rate by improving content relevance and CTAs
suggestions.problem: Only 3.3 engaged sessions per day average across 6.3 total sessions (52% engagement rate). This suggests over half of visitors are not interacting with bakery/cafe content, indicating potential content-audience mismatch.
suggestions.root_cause: Generic landing page content, unclear site value proposition, or traffic from non-bakery/cafe interest audiences. Users may not understand what Chirumaru offers or how to discover bakeries/cafes on the platform.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a prominent hero section on homepage with 'Discover [Number] Bakeries & Cafes Near You' and a sticky search/filter bar. Create focused landing pages for each traffic source (e.g., /from/instagram, /from/twitter) with pre-filtered content. Add exit-intent popup: '3 hidden gem bakeries in [region]?' to re-engage bouncing users.
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engagement rate from 52% to 70%+, converting 1-2 additional sessions daily into engaged users. Estimated 20-30% improvement in overall site engagement metric.
suggestions.implementation_note: Example exit-intent JavaScript: document.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) { if(e.clientY < 50) { showPopup({message: '〇〇地域の隠れた名店を見つけませんか？', cta: 'おすすめを見る'}); }});
